target.name: RW Aurigae
target.notes: Classical T Tauri variable star in Taurus-Auriga. Enters detector non-linear regime; brightness comparisons must be grouped strictly by spectral band/wavelength to avoid confusing its steep infrared disk excess SED with temporal variability.

scientific_warnings: 180-degree spacecraft roll (SPS_EPA) flip detected across survey passes; all frames have been WCS-reprojected onto a common North-up, East-left TAN grid.

SPHEREx Linear Variable Filters sample a different wavelength per exposure. Compare brightness strictly within the same detector band to distinguish true variability from the star's spectral energy distribution (SED).
Detector core saturation (OVERFLOW / NaN core) detected in 22/24 frames. Visual cores are reconstructed from the 98th-percentile PSF halo; astrometric centroids use halo center-of-mass.
